title: Line sketch: Melodic Ribbons in Motion
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: Abstract composition merges swirling ribbons of color with integrated musical staves, clefs, and notes. Overlapping curved bands in, and earth tones create dynamic flow across an off-white ground. Bold and flat planes emphasize rhythm and movement (derived from painting #60).
